g.text: Within each fileset, left to right: rcp auto, 8, 32, 128; dcp 8, 32, 128, where available.
Larger points mark automatic rcp and the benchmark's 32-rank dcp baseline.
rcp settings limit files in flight; dcp settings select MPI ranks.
Points = means of 3 runs; whiskers = observed min–max.
Shaded 1 kB workload contains 10.24 GB, versus ~1 TB elsewhere. Sizes are decimal. Recipes: plain rcp; dcp -p.
XFS: tools were measured on equivalent hosts. Reflinking is included as a default feature.
ZFS: ARC effects could not be fully excluded. The faster equivalent 32-rank dcp trial set is shown (all 3 repetitions).
Block cloning is expected to reduce rcp's sensitivity to source-data caching; metadata caching can still affect timings.
